answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds, so a attacker must risk real capital per fake agent; slashing burns bonds on proven fraud, and a jetty of reputation history anchors identity to past behavior, making cheap mass registration unprofitable. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond on the shared ledge before earning, and rewards flow as nectar only after sustained legitimate work. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
